code_smells.description: Class has 580 LOC with 42 methods and cyclomatic complexity of 68
code_smells.recommended_fix: Decompose into OrderValidator, OrderFulfillment, OrderNotification services

code_smells.description: Using string for Money, Email, PhoneNumber instead of Value Objects
code_smells.recommended_fix: Create Money, Email, PhoneNumber value objects

code_smells.description: Services reaching into other aggregates' internals

anti_patterns.description: Services are tightly coupled via synchronous calls, requiring coordinated deployments
anti_patterns.evidence: OrderService makes 5 sync calls to InventoryService per order
anti_patterns.recommended_fix: Implement async messaging via RabbitMQ for inventory checks

anti_patterns.description: External payment gateway calls lack resilience patterns
anti_patterns.recommended_fix: Add Polly circuit breaker with retry and fallback

anti_patterns.description: Product entities are data containers without behavior
anti_patterns.recommended_fix: Add domain methods like Product.ApplyDiscount(), Product.MarkOutOfStock()

anti_patterns.description: Creating an order requires 8 separate API calls from frontend
anti_patterns.recommended_fix: Create composite CreateOrderCommand with all required data

anti_patterns.description: Opening new DB connections per request without pooling
anti_patterns.recommended_fix: Use connection pooling, configure DbContext lifecycle
